reasons: Deviation is correctly identified: Section 4.1 imposes a 90-day non-renewal/termination notice window, exceeding both the preferred 30-day and fallback 60-day limits and sitting at the walk-away boundary; the one-year renewal term is correctly noted as acceptable.

Redline reaches the preferred position with a targeted edit: 'ninety (90)' → 'thirty (30)' days plus a single added sentence requiring HDI to give a renewal reminder 60 days before each anniversary. The flagged changed-character ratio (0.682) is driven by the inserted reminder sentence, which the rule expressly calls for, so it is not an over-edit.
Comment is accurate, in-tone, prefixed, states what changed and why, cites the playbook position, and offers the 60-day fallback.
Omitting a price-increase cap is defensible on the stated facts (revenue-share fees on Net Sales with no unilateral uplift mechanism), so the rule is not left incomplete.

Minor drafting nits worth fixing before sending (not disqualifying): the new reminder sentence is inserted immediately before 'Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated,' so 'Such notice' now reads as referring to the renewal reminder rather than the termination notice — place the reminder sentence after that sentence or use 'Such termination notice.' Also, the shortened window is bilateral, letting HDI exit on 30 days' notice; consider limiting the 30-day window to Company's non-renewal/termination right if continuity matters.
